_meta.description: Curated inventory of YouTube videos relevant to Flame Python scripting, for Phase D transcript extraction
_meta.status: seed — run fetch_transcripts.py on Mac to populate transcripts

logik_live.description: Community-run Logik.tv show covering Flame workflows, tools, and scripting.

episodes.title: Writing Python Scripts for Flame with Andy Milkis and Frederic Warren
episodes.notes: Foundational episode — beginner to intermediate Python scripting for Flame. Covers the range of what's possible with the Flame Python API.

episodes.title: Python Scripts and the Uppercut Workflow with John Geehreng
episodes.notes: Real-world production automation — Uppercut (NYC) workflow. Project creation, shot publishing, renaming, Frame.io integration, delivery. Feb 2024.

episodes.title: Simple Python Scripts with Bryan Bayley
episodes.notes: Practical beginner scripts — append start frame to clip name, source timecode manipulation. Feb 2024.

episodes.title: Python Fun with Andrew Miller and Erik Borzi
episodes.notes: Most recent dedicated Python episode. Andrew Miller (Autodesk) and Erik Borzi. Likely covers newer API features.

episodes.title: Logik.tv - Python Script to change the color of segments in the timeline
episodes.notes: Short demo clip (~17s). Timeline segment color manipulation via Python.

flame_learning_channel.description: Official Autodesk Flame Learning Channel. Short, didactic tutorials covering Flame features per release.

episodes.title: Python Scripting - OpenClip and Watch Folders
episodes.notes: First Python scripting episode on the official channel. Covers watch folder automation and OpenClip workflow via Python.

episodes.title: Python - Installing Logik Shaders in Flame
episodes.notes: Python script for installing Logik matchbox shaders. Demonstrates scripted asset management.

episodes.title: Python Scripting - Batch Iteration and Render Naming
episodes.notes: Batch automation and render output naming via Python. Directly relevant to batch group scripting patterns.

episodes.title: Working with Python Scripting
episodes.notes: Updated Python scripting overview for Flame 2018.2. Covers new hooks and API additions in that release cycle.

episodes.title: Adding Custom Menu Actions
episodes.notes: Creating custom menu actions via Python hooks. Core pattern for building Flame tools.

episodes.title: Python - Browsers and Messaging
episodes.notes: New Python features in Flame 2023.1: PyTransition for Timeline, MediaHub browser controls, messaging/dialog API.
